notes: Four own pages read, all HTTP 200 and not thin; the pricing page settles every price, plan and free-tier claim, and the security page settles hosting. No claim is wrong or stale, so no cited page was read for causes. Not coded: the q3 Perplexity run 1 category-wide range ('entry-level plans often start around $7-$11 per user per month for tools like ClickUp, monday.com, and Asana', hedged and not specific to ClickUp), hedged plan lines ('Workload availability and limits vary by subscription', 'Availability and limits vary by plan', q7 ChatGPT runs 1 to 3), the 'everything app' positioning line, the count of views (15+ ways to view, a capability), the Workspaces, Spaces, Folders and Lists hierarchy and feature names (Docs, Whiteboards, Chat, Workload), which are capabilities, not naming facts. In q5 Claude run 1 the line about free tiers for teams of 5 to 10 people was coded only as a free-tier claim (C05), since it states suitability, not a user limit. 'Most of these platforms offer free trials' (q3 Claude run 3) names no vendor and was not coded. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser snapshots exist for ClickUp and no claim was unverifiable for a blocked or thin page; the five gap lines are the hedged category-wide price range, the generic free-trials line and three 'integrated team communication' capability lines (q7 Claude runs 1 to 3), all out of scope; a scan of every table and ClickUp sub-heading in the full answers found only capability, best-for and rating cells plus the prices and plan lines already coded (and the unspecific 'Guest-seat limits deserve attention' in q2 ChatGPT run 2), so no claim or instance was added; no wrong or stale claim to check.
